meta.disclaimer: Timetables from the Isle of Man Railways 2026 published timetable. Operational constraints may apply and services can change — always confirm at rail.im or /IoMRailways before travelling. Manx One is not affiliated with Isle of Man Railways.
meta.notes: Each railway has a date→code calendar and a set of lettered timetables. Two letters (e.g. DE) mean both timetables run that day. A date absent from the calendar means no service.
meta.faresNote: Fares as published in the Isle of Man Railways 2026 timetable. Always confirm current prices before travelling.

railways.name: Manx Electric Railway
railways.note: Intermediate stops are by request other than Laxey. To board, give a clear hand signal to the motorman; to alight, tell the conductor when boarding.

railways.note: Celebrating 150 years in 2026. Trams may currently board at the temporary terminus, Broadway Halt, Central Promenade.

rows.journey: Single ticket
Day ticket (unlimited journeys that day)

notes: Child fares apply to ages 5-15. Under 5s travel free with a fare-paying adult (restrictions apply).
Dogs may be carried at £0.30 per journey.
Go Explore Cards and Go Platinum Rail cards are accepted. Go Silver, all Go Gold, Go Saver and Go Places cards are NOT valid on the Horse Tramway.
Single tickets are valid for one journey on the day of issue.
